objective: GO of 2026-11-23 from COPYING-PARTS-20261123-001 (direction 1; sub-goal B323, goals G5 with G18), under the owner's standing authorization and his question whether time is a pattern like the others. RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001 found that the round for the whole growth can be replaced by rounds taken part by part, and that a law in which every knot reads again after each birth jams. Find whether a law exists in which a birth is made one at a time from what is built alone, each knot reading only a bounded number of steps out and only when what it reads can no longer change, that builds in every order what the complete rounds build: for the laws with a ration fixed at birth, for the ring that returns (with waiting), and for ordinary growth. First step: read what the record's guarded serial rule (SERIAL-REPAIRS-20261120-001) already establishes, so as not to repeat it. First discriminator: every order of births on the cycle of four through dead knots. Stop at a law that matches the complete rounds in every order with a statement of what it reads, or at a proof that each law of a stated family does not.
title: A round read locally: can the knots of one part read at different moments?
